id.title: 2048 · Tools SagalaIT
id.lead: Geser ubin, gabungkan angka yang sama, dan capai ubin target. Papan 3×3 sampai 6×6; permainan tersimpan di browser ini.
id.how1: Panah atau WASD menggeser semua ubin.
id.how2: Di ponsel, geser jari di atas papan.
id.how3: Dua ubin sama yang bertabrakan bergabung, sekali per geseran.
id.how4: Z atau U mengurungkan langkah terakhir (sampai 3 kali).
id.how5: Skor terbaik dan permainan tersimpan di browser ini, terpisah untuk tiap ukuran papan.
id.win_p: Kamu mencapai ubin {target}. Mau lanjut main?
id.over_p: Skor akhir {score}. Urungkan satu langkah atau mulai dari awal.

en.title: 2048 · Tools SagalaIT
en.lead: Slide tiles, merge equal numbers, and reach the target tile. Boards from 3×3 to 6×6; your game is saved in this browser.
en.how1: Arrow keys or WASD slide all tiles.
en.how2: On a phone, swipe on the board.
en.how3: Two equal tiles that collide merge, once per move.
en.how4: Z or U undoes the last move (up to 3 times).
en.how5: Your best score and current game are saved in this browser, separately for each board size.
en.win_p: You reached the {target} tile. Keep playing?
en.over_p: Final score {score}. Undo a move or start over.
en.confirm_p: Your score of {score} will be lost.
